from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545186/attempts/ab0e7680e4554c07981a60f2f64ec0d8/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # The full-height nonzero divider separates two aligned masks.
    divider = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] != 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
